content: For individuals diagnosed with both diabetes and hypertension, the American Diabetes Association (ADA) advises the use of either angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors or angiotensin receptor blockers (ARBs). This recommendation is particularly emphasized in cases where there is evidence of moderate to severe albuminuria, defined as a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) between 30–299 mg/g or a UACR of 300 mg/g or greater.
